title: 第13章 这里不能再待了！-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    许默满脸通红地挪开视线。

    非礼勿视。

    再看下去，掉的可就不只是理智值了。

    就在此时，不远处的草丛里传出一阵极其细微的窸窣声。

    几只充当眼线的变异黑蚁悄无声息地爬出枯叶，其中一只顺着许默的战靴一路攀爬，最终停留在他的肩头。

    细长的触角微微摩擦着他的颈部皮肤，一股模糊却急切的意念顺着触角传递过来。

    周围暂时安全。

    许默将沸腾的热火强行压下。

    狂暴状态还有时间，不能浪费。

    他抡起战术手斧，再次扑向旁边一棵腰粗的乔木。

    果然，攻击力增加，就连砍树都加快速度了。

    斧刃撕裂木质的闷响在丛林边缘极有节奏地回荡。

    木屑飞溅中，许默能清晰地感觉到体内的力量正在被快速抽离，体力槽一路跌破了80大关，呼吸也逐渐变得粗重。

    但他砍得毫无顾忌。

    方芸悄无声息地游走在他身后十米开外，左手斧子右手弓，随时处于发力状态。

    这种把后背完全交给另一个人的感觉，许默本以为自己一生绝不会有，没想到，到了诡异的生存世界，他反而有了这种感觉。

    “停下。”

    方芸的声音从左侧传来。

    许默瞬间收力，虽不知方芸何意，但对方既然提醒，肯定是有异常。

    他反手将斧头护在胸前，脚步轻点靠了过去。

    顺着方芸视线望去，一丛低矮的灌木隐藏在茂密的蕨类植物之间。

    繁茂的绿叶下，密密麻麻地缀满了龙眼大小的红浆果，表皮还挂着晶莹的露水。

    洞察之眼开启，浮现出果子的属性，介绍里就俩字：能吃。

    两人对视一眼，默契地矮下身子，蹲在齐膝深的草丛里小心翼翼地采撷。

    红浆果入口即化，酸甜的汁液在干涸的口腔里炸开，化作丝丝缕缕的凉意抚平着胃部的灼烧感。

    带不走的，两人干脆就地分食，直到干渴和饱腹的数值双双往上抬了一截，连衣服口袋都被塞得鼓鼓囊囊。

    就在这时，那只停在许默肩头的黑蚁突然焦躁起来，顺着他的手臂快速爬到手背上，原地疯狂打转。

    许默立刻停下咀嚼的动作，眼神微凝。

    “它好像要带我们看什么东西。”

    方芸咽下果肉，反手握紧石斧，示意许默带路。

    两人跟着那只黑蚁，穿梭在杂草丛中。

    大约走了十几米，前方一处被藤蔓遍布的低洼地里，隐约露出了一个四四方方的木质轮廓。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Xu Mo looked away with a blush on his face.

"Don't look at anything inappropriate."

​​Looking further, it’s not just the sanity points that have been lost.

At this moment, an extremely subtle rustling sound came from the grass not far away.

Several mutated black ants acting as eyeliners crawled out of the dead leaves silently. One of them climbed along Xu Mo's boots and finally stopped on his shoulder.

The slender tentacles lightly rubbed the skin of his neck, and a vague but urgent thought was transmitted along the tentacles.

The surrounding area is temporarily safe.

Xu Mo forced down the boiling heat.

There is still time in the violent state, so don’t waste it.

He swung his tactical ax and pounced on a waist-thick tree next to him again.

Sure enough, with the increase in attack power, even cutting down trees has become faster.

The muffled sound of the ax blade tearing through the wood echoed rhythmically at the edge of the jungle.

Amidst the flying sawdust, Xu Mo could clearly feel that the power in his body was being rapidly withdrawn. His physical strength gauge dropped below the 80 mark, and his breathing gradually became heavier.

But he cut without any scruples.

Fang Yun was walking quietly ten meters away behind him, with the ax in her left hand and the bow in her right hand, ready to go.

Xu Mo thought he would never have this feeling of completely handing over his back to another person in his life. Unexpectedly, in the strange world of survival, he would feel this way instead.

"Stop."

Fang Yun’s voice came from the left.

Xu Mo withdrew his strength instantly. Although he didn't know what Fang Yun meant, since the other party reminded him, there must be something abnormal.

He held the ax in front of his chest with his backhand and leaned forward lightly.

​ Looking along Fang Yun’s line of sight, a clump of low shrubs was hidden among the dense ferns.

Under the lush green leaves, there are densely covered red berries the size of longan, with crystal dew still hanging on the surface.

The eye of insight is opened, and the attributes of the fruit are revealed. There are only two words in the introduction: edible.

The two looked at each other, tacitly lowered themselves, squatted in the knee-deep grass, and picked carefully.

The red berries melt in your mouth, and the sweet and sour juice explodes in your dry mouth, turning into wisps of coolness to soothe the burning sensation in your stomach.

Since they couldn’t take anything with them, the two simply shared the food on the spot, until the thirst and fullness levels both increased, and even the pockets of their clothes were filled to the brim.

At this moment, the black ant parked on Xu Mo's shoulder suddenly became anxious, quickly crawled along his arm to the back of his hand, and circled crazily in place.

Xu Mo immediately stopped chewing and his eyes narrowed slightly.

"It seems to be showing us something."

Fang Yun swallowed the pulp, held the stone ax tightly in her backhand, and signaled Xu Mo to lead the way.

The two of them followed the black ant through the weeds.

After walking about ten meters, a square wooden outline was vaguely revealed in a low-lying area covered with vines.
